title: A gift with little to give
odia:
ଅଗସ୍ତି ଦେଲେ ଦାନ
କଷା ଗୁଆକୁ ପଚା ପାନ ।
literal_meaning: Agasti gave a gift: astringent areca nut and rotten betel leaf.
explanation: The announcement of generosity is undercut by the poor gift itself. This is an editorial reading of the contrast; the rhyme does not establish a historical donor or event.
meaning_odia: ଦାନର ନାଁ ବଡ଼ ହେଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦିଆଯାଇଥିବା ଜିନିଷର କାମ ନ ଥାଇପାରେ। ଏଠାରେ ଦାନର ଘୋଷଣା ଓ ତାହାର ମାନ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ତଫାତ ଦିଶେ।
usage_example: A celebrated equipment donation turns out to consist of unusable machines. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source gives no explanatory gloss. Agasti is not identified here with a verified person; no antiquity claim follows from the name.
